prompt:
Use case: ui-mockup
Asset type: high-fidelity desktop landing-page direction comp, 1440×900 landscape
Primary request: Render the edge-to-edge first viewport for “Quản Lý Dạy Thêm”, a Vietnamese multi-center tutoring operations product. The visitor must immediately understand that the product connects center approval, role access, class scheduling, teaching sessions, registration and attendance, and can begin the real sign-in action.
Real content: product name “Quản Lý Dạy Thêm”; headline “Một nhịp vận hành, mọi trung tâm”; states “Duyệt trung tâm”, “Phân quyền”, “Xếp lịch”, “Điểm danh”; form labels “Tên đăng nhập”, “Mật khẩu”; action “Đăng nhập”; supporting link “Quên mật khẩu?”.
Composition: a single oversized horizontal operations dossier unfolds across the whole page, not a generic split hero. Its routing strip carries the four states in reading order; the open action tab contains a usable login form, while a quiet lower continuation proves the world can extend into daily work. Include a compact product mark, minimal navigation “Tổng quan · Vận hành · Bảo mật”, and a small system-status utility at the far edge.
Visual law: cool fibrous white is the ground, deep navy is institutional ink, jade owns active/verified regions, mango marks pending, and vermilion marks exceptions. Use a sturdy Vietnamese-friendly grotesk, crisp index tabs, flat status stamps, and one animated-looking routing trace. Make the screen feel calm, modern and accountable, never bureaucratic.
Constraints: crisp readable Vietnamese, functional website interface, no browser chrome, no device mockup, no stock-photo people, no floating glass cards, no generic blue SaaS gradient, no watermark.
